summary_en: ROE and ROIC designated as key management metrics alongside operating margin. Target improvements through revenue strengthening and capital efficiency gains via focused market development, optimized production-sales-inventory management, and new Yokohama plant productivity. 3-year medium-term plan (FY2025–2027) horizon.
title_en: Response toward Realization of Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: NKK Switches announced on 25 June 2026 a strategic response framework to advance management conscious of cost of capital and stock price. The company's 5-year performance review (FY2022–2026) shows ROE averaging 2.90%, well below the TSE Standard Market manufacturing average of approximately 6.0%, and ROIC declining from 10.13% (FY2022) to 2.86% (FY2026). Although PER at 13.75× remains in line with market peers (8–14×), the low PBR of 0.31× is primarily attributable to below-market ROE rather than valuation compression. The board resolved to adopt ROE and ROIC as key management metrics alongside the traditionally emphasized operating margin. A 3-year medium-term plan (FY2025–2027) will pursue revenue strengthening through focused market penetration in broadcast/acoustics, special vehicles, and emerging robotics sectors, and capital efficiency gains via optimized production-sales-inventory (PSI) management, working capital compression, and productivity improvement leveraging the new Yokohama plant. The company targets PBR uplift and sustained enterprise value creation through disciplined ROE and ROIC recovery.
